## Historical Legacies and Development

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-10}

Winter 2023, 2024

Instructor for a master-level elective course. The course focuses on the use of history in social scientific research.

## Nationalism and Ethnic Conflict

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-10}

Fall 2021

Instructor for a master-level elective course. The course focuses on the rise and resilience of nationalism, its role in conflict and war, but also in other fields, including economic development and public goods provision.

:::

:::


## Education and Inequality

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-10}

January 2020

Substitute instructor for a 200-level introductory course on sociology. The course focuses on the mechanisms by which educational institutions foster and maintain equalities and inequalities around the world.

:::

:::


## Sociological Perspectives

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-10}

Summer 2019, Fall 2021

Instructor for a 200-level introductory course on sociology. The course introduced students to a wide range of topics including (but not limited to) social inequality and social class, race and ethnicity, gender, deviance and social movements.

:::

:::

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-10}

Instructor for a 200-level introductory course on sociology of global development.
